It extracts intricate clinical tables with high precision and reliable accuracy, converting them into editable formats while keeping your document structure intact. Save hours of manual work and speed up your workflow.

records.name: Word Scrambler
records.tagline: Unscramble letters and solve anagrams instantly, for free
records.description: Word Scrambler, Unscramble letters, solve anagrams, and crack Wordle or Quordle instantly. Free, no sign-up, 246,000-word dictionary. Try it now.

records.name: Join the Waitlist
records.tagline: Join FLIRTTR now
records.description: Flirttr is the next-gen social app with reels, stories, meaningful connections, live streams, gifts & earn. Join the waitlist now.

records.name: BrandCast
records.tagline: Turn a folder of audio into branded social videos
records.description: Drag in a folder of audio or video files and BrandCast turns each one into a branded social video: your logo, QR code, an animated waveform, and the filename as the title. Renders horizontal and vertical at once, 100% offline on your Mac. No uploads, no subscription. Free version with watermark; $79 lifetime license (code LAUNCH = 25% off). Built by a musician who needed 600 videos for his own music channel.

records.name: GhostList
records.tagline: Find out who unfollowed you
records.description: Upload your Instagram data export to see who unfollowed you and who doesn't follow you back. No password, no API, no ban risk.

records.name: Woh Din — Certificate of Arrival
records.tagline: Wha did India look like the day you were born?
records.description: Woh Din generates a ceremonial "Certificate of Arrival" for any Indian birth date (1950-2026) featuring birth moon phase & traditional Tithi, historical weather in your birth city, #1 Binaca Geetmala retro radio song, front-page newspaper headlines, inflation benchmarks (Petrol, Milk, Gold, Cinema), Time Capsule savings slider, and Savage Birthday Roast diploma.

records.name: Low/No Cost Checking from Banks
records.tagline: No overdraft fees, low minimums, real digital tools.
records.description: Find the lowest-cost checking account. We analyze the fine print of hundreds of banks to surface certified accounts with no overdraft fees.

records.name: Listently
records.tagline: Turn any conversation into text
records.description: Turn any conversation into an accurate, speaker-labeled transcript in minutes. Upload audio, video, or links, get AI summaries, and export anywhere.

records.name: Ai Clip Cutter
records.tagline: Turn long videos into captioned, post-ready vertical clips
records.description: AI Clip Cutter turns long-form videos like podcasts and interviews into short, post-ready vertical clips. It transcribes your upload with word-level timestamps, scores candidate moments for hook strength, density, self-containedness, and emotion, and explains why each clip was chosen so you stay in control. Approve picks, tweak trim points, and export 9:16 clips at 1080×1920 with burned-in captions using 18 style presets. Credits are pay-as-you-go and billed in INR through Razorpay.

records.name: Wulver: Daily Workout Streaks
records.tagline: A wolf coach and a streak you'll fight to protect
records.description: Wulver turns bodyweight fitness into a streak game. Answer three questions and AI builds you a plan, then a wolf coach demonstrates every exercise while streaks, XP and ranks (Pup to Alpha) make tomorrow's workout the one you don't want to skip. No equipment. No gym. 20 to 30 minutes a day. iPhone. Wulver Pro subscription required: $49.99/year with a 7-day free trial, or $9.99/month.

records.name: AICINEO
records.tagline: The streaming platform built for AI filmmakers
records.description: AICINEO is a streaming and showcase platform created specifically for AI filmmakers and AI-generated entertainment. Creators can showcase films, shorts, series and original AI content to a growing audience, while viewers can discover a new generation of filmmaking. AICINEO gives AI creators a dedicated home to share their work, build an audience, be discovered and make money.

records.name: Yukinova Energy
records.tagline: Hybrid Solar Inverter
records.description: Discover Yukinova hybrid solar inverter for homes and businesses. Efficient energy management with reliable performance and smart solar power backup.

records.name: Teleprompter
records.tagline: The teleprompter that scrolls at the speed of your voice
records.description: Write your script, open the camera, record. The text scrolls while you look at the lens and is never burned into the video. Voice scrolling follows your reading pace with on-device speech recognition in 10 languages. Android, free with a Pro upgrade.

records.name: R.SPACE
records.tagline: Buy, sell, invest in any country, from anywhere in the world
records.description: Real estate is the largest market in the world. $326 trillion. There is no single global platform yet where you can see new developer launches across different countries, secondary market listings, rental properties and close a deal, all in one place. R.Space is the first AI platform where the entire global real estate market comes together. Buy, sell, invest in any country, from anywhere in the world.

records.name: SpeedyFundsNow
records.tagline: Best No Credit Check Loans in USA for Borrowers
records.description: Get the Best No Credit Check Loans in USA with SpeedyFundsNow—fast approvals, trusted lenders, and flexible terms. Apply today for 2026!

records.name: Dr Knsm Hospital
records.tagline: Best Pediatrician in Lucknow
records.description: Consult the best pediatrician in Lucknow at Dr KNSM Hospital. Trusted baby doctor & child specialist offering the complete pediatric care near you in Lucknow.
